### Prerequisites

<!-- Please put an X between the brackets as you perform the following steps: -->

* [ ] Check that your issue is not already filed:
      https://github.com/leanprover/vscode-lean4/issues
* [ ] Check that the issue is in the VS Code extension and not in Lean itself.
      Report issues in Lean itself (for example, a wrong error message or a crash of the Lean server) at
      https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/issues
* [ ] Reduce the issue to a minimal, self-contained, reproducible test case.
      If possible, avoid dependencies on Mathlib or Batteries.
* [ ] Test your test case with the latest version of the extension.
* [ ] If the issue is a security vulnerability, do not report it here.
      Write to security@lean-fro.org for responsible disclosure.
